description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You begin or Sustain THE ORBIT.

Begin a second ORBIT on another target within range, at no additional action cost. The second pull moves its subjects 2 feet toward one another each round rather than 5, and does not increase. Sustaining either ORBIT sustains both; if either ends, the other continues.

cinderfall.incomplete: Extends THE ORBIT (a forced-movement pull mechanic) to a second target -- no forced-movement/pull/drag rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source (confirmed by listing every file in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/; NOMOVE), so THE ORBIT and anything built on it is unbuildable via system.rules.
